payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign whose live session's player view shows the base; absent, the campaign of the instance sent
payload.instance: uuid — kind 'battlemap': a battlemap instance of the session (base-coherent)
payload.media: uuid — kind 'illustration': an illustration of the session's campaign (base-coherent)
payload.zoom: number above 0, below 1000 — the framing's zoom; 1 when absent
payload.panX: number — the framing's horizontal pan, in pixels; 0 when absent
payload.panY: number — the framing's vertical pan, in pixels; 0 when absent
